title: Reimbursement Ledger Rule — Recoupment of a Paid Home Oxygen Therapy Equipment Month
content:
# Recoupment of a Paid Equipment Month — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Rule.** A recoupment of a paid Home Oxygen Therapy equipment month is recorded against that one month as the original line, one reversal per month named in the payer's letter, and a paid month is reversed at most once. The reversed month leaves the paid count, every patient charge stemming from it is removed under the coverage rules, and a patient payment already made on it becomes a credit.

## Elements

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| What a reversal is recorded against | the one paid month, as its original line |
| How many reversals per letter | one per month named in the payer's letter |
| How often a paid month may be reversed | at most once |
| Effect on the paid count | the reversed month leaves it |
| Patient charges stemming from the month | removed under the coverage rules |
| A patient payment already made on the month | becomes a credit |

The "at most once" limit is judged on the system record: the reversals already recorded against the same original line.

## Hypothetical illustration

A payer's letter names three paid months. Three reversals are recorded, one against each month. If one of those months already carries a reversal, it is not reversed again. Each reversed month drops out of the paid count, and a patient payment already made on any of them becomes a credit.
